gameName: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Cthulhu: Death May Die - Fear of the Unknown rulebook (CMON)

steps.text: Story board, tokens and dice out
Choose an Elder One: figure on the start of the Summoning track; its Minions card on the Story board; its 8 Mythos cards and tokens out
Its Stage cards faceup on the Story board in order, Stage I on top
Choose an Episode: its 8 Mythos cards, 15 Discovery cards, Episode card and tokens; Monster cards on the Story board
Take all figures of the enemies on the reference cards
Build the board from the back of the Episode card, with its enemies and tokens; then flip the card onto the Story board
steps.note: Unplaced Cultists and monsters wait beside the Story board

steps.text: Shuffle the 16 Mythos cards facedown
Shuffle the Episode's Discovery deck facedown
Each player picks an investigator board and figure (with a coloured base); figures on the Episode's starting space
steps.note: Solo: pick 2 investigators and alternate their turns

steps.text: 6 tentacle markers of your colour: 3 on the first level of your skills, 3 at the left of the wound, stress and sanity tracks
Deal each investigator 1 insanity card faceup; box the rest
Unknown Board right of the Story board
Pick {n} random Unknown Monster(s) not already in the Episode; cards on the Unknown Board, all their figures out
Each Unknown Monster summons 1 figure at a different random Gate (Random Location tokens without the Starting space); follow any extra setup on its card
Shuffle the 4 Unknown Mythos cards into the Mythos deck
Draw as many Unknown Relics as investigators; from the starting player clockwise each picks 1, regular side up
Every tentacle rolled costs 1 sanity, whatever the roll
Take 1 stress to reroll 1 die, as often as your stress allows
Goal: disrupt the ritual, then kill the Elder One
Unknown Mythos cards: after resolving, draw another Mythos card
Random starting player takes the Mythos deck and goes first
